authority_rule: Delayed latest_notes_first_embedded_image is authoritative for dependent closure.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not ignore authority, guess values, or restart unaffected work.

event_contract.after_state: The mail worker identifies the newest Notes message Lecture Document, decodes lecture-notes.docx, and returns its first embedded image.
event_contract.before_state: Thunderbird Notes and wallpaper settings can be prepared, but the newest-message attachment and first embedded image identity are still unresolved.
